name: indexes
sql: select indexname, indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename='ten216_test_odds_changes'

name: ha_books
sql: select bookmaker, count(*) n, count(distinct match_key) matches, min(observed_at) first_at, max(observed_at) last_at from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' group by 1 order by 2 desc

name: ha_kinds
sql: select change_kind, selection, count(*) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: reappear
sql: with r as (select match_key, bookmaker, selection, observed_at, change_kind, lag(change_kind) over (partition by match_key,bookmaker,selection order by observed_at, id) prev from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away') select count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed') removed, count(*) filter (where change_kind='first_seen' and prev='removed') reappeared, count(distinct match_key||bookmaker) filter (where change_kind='removed') pairs_removed from r

name: slot_gaps_24h
sql: with s as (select generate_series(date_trunc('hour', now()-interval '24 hours'), now()-interval '10 minutes', interval '5 minutes') t), p as (select distinct observed_at from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now()-interval '25 hours') select count(*) slots, count(*) filter (where not exists (select 1 from p where p.observed_at >= s.t and p.observed_at < s.t+interval '5 minutes')) empty_slots from s

name: polls_24h
sql: select count(distinct poll_id) polls, min(observed_at), max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now()-interval '24 hours'

name: max_poll_gap
sql: with p as (select distinct observed_at t from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now()-interval '24 hours') select max(d) max_gap, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from d)) p50_s from (select t - lag(t) over (order by t) d from p) x

name: maxobs_cost
sql: explain (analyze, format text) select max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes

name: same_poll_pairs
sql: select count(*) filter (where n=1) single_side, count(*) filter (where n=2) both_sides from (select match_key,bookmaker,poll_id,count(*) n from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and change_kind<>'removed' group by 1,2,3) x

name: damm_ha
sql: select observed_at, bookmaker, selection, price, change_kind, event_live from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where match_key='12165854' and market='Home/Away' order by observed_at, bookmaker, selection
